title: Thousands join Qingdao's Dragon Boat Festival celebration
text:
Thousands join Qingdao's Dragon Boat Festival celebration
On June 16, Qingdao hosted a vibrant Dragon Boat Festival event in Chengyang district, featuring folk displays, interactive activities, cultural talks, and volunteer services.
One highlight was the zongzi-making contest, where 1,660 residents gathered to showcase their skills in making zongzi, a glutinous rice dumpling wrapped in bamboo or reed leaves. Creative zongzi displays, intangible cultural heritage exhibits, festive floats, and photo spots added to the lively atmosphere.
Qingdao has been expanding its "our festivals" cultural activities, regularly holding cultural performances and folk experiences during traditional holidays. Chengyang district's annual zongzi contest exemplifies the city's efforts to revitalize traditional festivals.
Looking ahead, Qingdao will continue to explore modern expressions of festival culture, making these traditions a meaningful part of community life.
Residents compete in a zongzi-making contest during Qingdao's Dragon Boat Festival celebration. [Photo provided to chinadaily.com.cn]
Creative zongzi displays and festive floats attract visitors at the cultural event in Chengyang district. [Photo provided to chinadaily.com.cn]
From handicraft booths to traditional performances, the festival brings community spirit and culture to life. [Photo provided to chinadaily.com.cn]
